indicator_definition: Proportion of assessed commercial fish stocks in EU waters fished at or below maximum sustainable yield (MSY), expressed as a percentage of all assessed stocks. Data compiled by ICES.
rationale: Overfishing depletes stocks and damages marine ecosystems. Progress means an increasing proportion of stocks fished within sustainable limits.
methodology_characteristics: Based on stock assessments conducted by ICES. Sustainability assessed relative to MSY. Covers commercially important stocks in EU and adjacent waters. Published annually.
